outputs.explanation: Panel A shows fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, merge) with no plot presenting averaged data.
The bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) show group means with error bars but no individual data points are overlaid.
Panel C is a Western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
The bar charts of SDH and COX signal intensity show group means with error bars (N indicated per bar) but no individual data points are shown.

Panel E consists of FACS histogram plots (cell counts vs TMRM intensity) and schematic diagrams; these are distribution/line-type plots, not bar charts of averages, so individual point overlay is not applicable.
